mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payrolls (PAYEMS) and fall in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits for positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 800 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand for housing, supporting construction and retail sectors for positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 800.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production index above 100 (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a rising CPIAUCSL signals monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending for positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.
